question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer refunds within 30 days for unused subscriptions. Contact support@example.com to initiate a refund.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password. You'll receive a verification email to complete the process.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and bank transfers (ACH). For enterprise plans we also support Net-30 invoicing.

question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
answer: Yes, you can change your plan at any time from Settings > Billing > Plan. Changes take effect on the next billing cycle.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our mobile app is available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Download it for on-the-go access.

question: How do I invite team members?
answer: Go to Settings > Team > Invite Members. Enter their email addresses and assign a role (Admin, Editor, Viewer).

question: Is my data secure?
answer: Yes, we use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant.

question: What is your uptime SLA?
answer: We guarantee 99.9% uptime for all paid plans. Enterprise plans include 99.99% SLA with dedicated support.
